_note: Copy to settings.local.json (gitignored), then add only the narrow, machine-specific allows you need (e.g. absolute tool paths). This is the recommended minimal safe baseline - never blanket 'Bash(bash *)' / 'Bash(git *)'. Scope any Read allows to the project tree plus the specific dirs you need (e.g. 'Read(<repo>/**)', 'Read(<home>/.claude/**)') - never the whole drive or whole home. The deny list and PreToolUse guard hooks are your real safety net; keep this allow-list tight.
